blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified XAUT implementation exposes owner-only addToBlockedList, removeFromBlockedList, and destroyBlockedFunds. transfer blocks the caller and transferFrom additionally blocks the source address. Tether Gold's terms also disclose transfer-freeze and token-destruction powers.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: XAUT is issuer-native on Ethereum, while XAUt0 locks XAUt in the Ethereum OFT adapter and mints equivalent representations across 14 destinations. At the near-synchronous 2026-07-21 inventory snapshot, the adapter held 29,714.544713 of 707,747.089000 minted XAUT (4.198469365% of minted supply). Destination supplies reconciled to 29,714.438956 XAUt0 (4.198454422% of minted supply), leaving an explicit 0.105757 XAUT timing/reconciliation residual (0.000014943% of minted supply). Those dated percentages are route-inventory diagnostics, not the V9 materiality denominator: runtime V9 uses fresh Tether authorized-minus-not-issued circulating liabilities only when the issuer values reconcile exactly to finalized total-supply and treasury-balance reads. Pharos scores the weakest durable route as external lock/mint because it depends on LayerZero/OFT lockbox infrastructure.

routes.reviewNote: On-chain 2026-07-20: canonical XAUt transparent proxy (implementation 0x4c0d2c74a8d26f1e4f5653021c521f5471f9e566, admin 0x856fcc085290ac1e40392442211e6a333afb873e) with owner() = 0xc6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828; the reviewed mintAuthority documents the issuer 3/6 multisig and onlyOwner mint/redeem. Canonical issuer-native deployment; the XAUt0 omnichain adapter locks this token. No bridge control carries the claim. At Ethereum block 25583977 on 2026-07-21, eth_call totalSupply() returned 707,747.089000 minted XAUT and balanceOf() for the official OFT adapter 0xb9c2321bb7d0db468f570d10a424d1cc8efd696c returned 29,714.544713 XAUT (4.198469365% of minted supply). The remaining 678,032.544287 minted XAUT outside the adapter is an inventory fact, not an economically circulating balance: runtime V9 subtracts the fresh issuer-disclosed not-issued amount only when it matches the pinned Tether treasury balance at the same finalized block. The destination total is 0.105757 XAUT below the adapter balance and remains an explicit timing/reconciliation residual.
